# Closet - Full Content

> Private, self-hosted household wardrobe organizer. Catalog garments with photos, build outfits, schedule them on a calendar, and share a wardrobe between users.

## Overview

Closet is a self-hosted fork of Libre Closet, licensed under the AGPL-3.0. It is a server-rendered progressive web app intended to be installed on a phone and used by a household. All data stays in a PostgreSQL database on the host that runs it.

## Features

### Garment catalog
Each garment has a photo, category, brand, size, colors, washing details, acquisition date and notes. Photos are uploaded to the server, which removes the background (BiRefNet, running server-side) and stores them as optimized WebP; nothing is processed in the browser. Categories are customizable and filterable.

### Outfit composer
Combine garments into saved outfits with a visual composer, with suggested outfits from the garments you own.

### Outfit calendar
Schedule outfits on a calendar to plan the week and see what has been worn.

### Wardrobe sharing
Share a wardrobe with another user through an invite link, with view-only or edit permission.

### Offline-tolerant PWA
Installs to the home screen and renders cached reads without a connection. Web Push notifications are supported when VAPID keys are configured.

### Wears, laundry and trips
Log what was worn and washed, see what is available, and pack for a trip from a packing list.

### Wishlist and inspiration
Keep a wishlist of garments to buy and a library of saved looks to recreate from your own wardrobe.

### Agent access
`/mcp` exposes the wardrobe to Claude and other agents with personal access tokens.

### Language
English only.

## Routes

- / - Today, the home screen
- /wardrobe - garment catalog
- /outfits - saved outfits and the outfit composer
- /calendar - outfit schedule
- /about - about and license attribution
- /auth/login - sign in (always required)

## Self-hosting

```bash
docker run -d \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -v closet_data:/app/data -e DATA_PATH=/app/data \
  -e ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" \
  -e DATABASE_HOST=<postgres host> -e DATABASE_NAME=closet \
  -e DATABASE_USER=closet -e DATABASE_PASS=<password> \
  ghcr.io/kashhq/closet:latest
```

It needs a PostgreSQL database and a session signing secret of at least 32
characters. See the README for docker-compose and environment variable options.

## Tech Stack

- **License:** AGPL-3.0
- **Backend:** Fastify (TypeScript), server-rendered JSX (hono/jsx)
- **Frontend:** htmx, Tailwind + daisyUI (server-rendered, no client framework)
- **Database:** PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM)
- **Images:** server-side background removal (BiRefNet on ONNX runtime, in a child process), sharp for WebP; photos are processed on the server, never in the browser
- **Offline:** Workbox service worker, Web Push
- **Storage:** local disk
- **Auth:** JWT session cookie, login always required
- **Deploy:** Docker image on GHCR
